0022600180.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (4-3, 1-2 on the road, 2nd in the Central and 2 games back) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 3-0 at home, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back), with Cleveland coming off a loss and Oklahoma City off a win. Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Jaylin Williams is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision. The Cavaliers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 117-112 loss in Cleveland on November 2, and they also lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season.
